title: ExperimentConfig
description: Configuration schema for blood-ion-repeat ionic channel experiments.

channel_medium.description: Description of the ionic channel medium (e.g. '0.9% saline').

symbol_period_ms.description: Duration allocated per symbol in milliseconds.

crc_mode.description: CRC algorithm used for frame integrity.

decode_threshold_mv.description: Receiver voltage threshold for decoding a '1' symbol (mV).

timestamp_seed_utc.description: Optional ISO-8601 UTC base time for deterministic timestamp generation. When absent, real wall-clock time is used.

trial_spacing_seconds.description: Simulated elapsed seconds between the start of consecutive trials.

symbol_spacing_seconds.description: Simulated elapsed seconds between symbols within a single trial.

noise_schedule_mv.description: Per-trial Gaussian noise standard deviation offset (mV). If shorter than trials, the last value is repeated. Omit to use the channel model default.
